newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NetComm sees better shareholder value.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NetComm sees better shareholder value.

text.p: Australian modem maker NetComm Ltd said on Thursday it expected to improve shareholder value in the current year.
"After some tough decisions and poor results in 1995, the strategies and 1996 results appear to be moving in the right direction," chairman George Maltby said in a statement.
"We remain optimistic of continuing further improvements in shareholder value."
Earlier, the company reported a net profit of A$1.75 million for the 12 months to June 30, compared with a loss of A$972,000 in the previous year.
"While the second half results were disappointing relative to the first half, and current trading is slower than expected, we anticipate that revenues and profits will continue to grow," Maltby said.
He said the company planned to expand offshore during the current year, which may require some continuing short term investment and possibly offshore fundraising.
At 12.15 p.m. (0215 GMT), NetComm shares were steady at A$1.36 on light turnover.
